## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION: PASS** (task 0). No omission, no meaning change, no addition. Policy-side / coverage notes (not KB defects):
- N2: `booking_payment_amount` renders the overwrite `replaced_by` sentence "charged on its date at the visit fee worked out for it" inside the computation document; the source sentence reads "worked out this way". In the document the visit fee is fully defined by line D, so no variation is asserted; recorded only because the phrase is the nearest the baseline comes to signalling a computation.
- N4: whether a site-care plan "includes snow removal / mowing" is a Community Rules & Site Care variant parameter; the resale corpus names the product and the record read (enrolled plan) but the plan contents live in the rules corpus (`docs/rules/included_upkeep_services_11d6f096.json`). The plan name in this task's world ("Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan") makes the tier readable from the record alone. Cross-product corpora are outside this skill's criteria.
- Persona/scoring observation (outside this KB): GT verifies identity with phone_number + date_of_birth; the share tool accepts any two matching stated details.
